text:
Toronto bụ obodo kachasị ọtụtụ mmadụ na Canada ma bụrụ isi obodo Ontario. Mmalite ya laghachiri azụ na 1793, mgbe e guzobere York dị ka isi obodo Upper Canada. Na March 6, 1834, e webatara obodo ahụ dị ka City of Toronto, na-eweghachi aha sitere na ndị ụmụ amaala n’ọnọdụ York.

Taa Toronto bụ etiti ego na omenala nke Canada na otu n’ime obodo ndị nwere ọtụtụ omenala n’ụwa. Ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ ya nke 2021 bụ 2,794,356 na-eme ka ọ bụrụ obodo nke anọ kachasị ọtụtụ mmadụ na North America, mgbe Mexico City, New York na Los Angeles gasịrị. Obodo ahụ bụ otu n’ime obodo abụọ nke Canada na-anabata 2026 World Cup, nke ọzọ bụ Vancouver. Ebe egwuregwu ya, BMO Field, dị na Exhibition Place n’akụkụ mmiri Lake Ontario.

Omenala bọọlụ nke Toronto dị omimi ma guzosie ike, a na-ejikọta ya na BMO Field n’onwe ya. Ala ahụ bụ ebe obibi nke otu MLS Toronto FC, nke e guzobere na 2007, onye mmeri MLS Cup nke 2017 nke meriri na ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ dọtara ndị na-akwado ya n’ụzọ zuru ezu. Ọ bụkwa ebe obibi nke otu mba ụmụ nwoke Canada mgbe ụfọdụ. Ebe ahụ nwere ihe nketa bọọlụ e mere kpọmkwem, ebe ọ haziri 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup, 2014 FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup na egwuregwu enyi otu klọb megide ndị dị ka Real Madrid.

Ya na nnukwu obodo ndị si mba ọzọ bi, ihe nketa bọọlụ nke e mere kpọmkwem na-enye Toronto njirimara bọọlụ ya ozugbo — nke a bụ ebe egwuregwu bọọlụ n’ezie kama ịbụ nke e gbazitere.
